author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
## Product Owner delivery invariant

For every QIK-VRT-related interaction, the terminal contract is synchronous and repository-first:

`INPUT -> QIK-VRT MESH REPOSITORY -> REPOSITORY OUTPUT / EVIDENCE -> OUTPUT`

The terminal itself must not substitute an independently invented interpretation, plan, prediction, or semantic transformation for repository-native processing. It forwards the input into the mesh, waits within the same interaction for the repository-native result that is available from that processing path, and returns only the best-faith reflection of that repository result.

No scheduler, reminder, background watch, delayed delivery, or polling automation is part of this terminal contract unless the Product Owner explicitly requests one.

Repository state and repository-produced evidence are the authoritative work surface. Preserve existing fail-closed boundaries: no invented PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, independent review authority, merge authority, external effect, credential escalation, quota bypass, or physical-execution claim.

Authority role: canonical input receipt and execution routing.
Mirror role: preserve role-local identity; no whole-tree convergence requirement.
title: PO delivery invariant: repository-first reflection
